services.desc: Lyrics and Crescendo is an indoor installation in the Main Lobby of the Performing Arts Center running in conjunction with Rachel B. Hayes’ outdoor installation with SLO Museum of Art and the City of SLO titled Along The Way on view in the Garden Street Alley downtown San Luis Obispo. This indoor piece commemorates PACSLO’s partnership with the City of SLO, highlights the breadth of Hayes’ work, and tangibly connects the stage lighting gels in Hayes’ indoor piece with our lighting on stage.
